title: Estate repos registry (CT-published; SCP-consumed)
description: Schema for `control-tower/config/estate_repos.yaml` per D-036 §Cross-references. SCP consumes this read-only via either a manifest-published or vendored snapshot — see RULE-003 §10 open question 1 + TF-RULE-003-002 for distribution-path discipline. SCP-R-006 Inv-B references `services[].service_id`; SCP-R-006 Inv-D references `services[].acc_sa_uuid`.

schema_version.description: Semver of the estate_repos.yaml schema shape. v1.4.0 ships at 1.0.0; additive field additions are PATCH; field removal or rename is MAJOR.

services.description: List of estate-known services. Order is not significant; lookup is by service_id.

service_id.description: Canonical service identifier. Matches `runtime_contract.allowed_callers[i]` shape per RULE-003 §3.1 Inv-A pattern. Must be unique within the registry.

acc_sa_uuid.description: ACC service-account UUID for cross-repo dispatch authentication per D-036 Element 1. At v1.4.0 this is a single shared UUID across all 9 estate repos (per D-036 Decision points item 5: shared key, single SA — and similarly, single UUID). Per-target HKDF-derived ephemeral subkeys deferred to TF-D036-008 v1.5.0+.

target_repo_app_id.description: GitHub App installation id for cross-repo dispatch (per D-036 Element 3). Optional; populated when the service has been onboarded as an ACC dispatch target.
